_about: Blade signs, drawn by the viewer. corner: where the sign meets the wall (x, z); dir: the way it sticks out (unit x, z: here the corner's outward bisector); out: m from the corner along dir; base, top: m up (from the lidar's returns off the sign); thick: m. panels top to bottom, each a share of the height: 'logo' (white box, red mark), 'letters' (red, stacked), 'number' (white box, black digits, red rim). Canopies (kind 'canopy'): start, a point on the wall (x, z); along, the wall's direction (unit x, z); length m along it; out m from the wall (to the outside: the left of along); base, top m up; text on the front fascia, framed in brass. Panels (kind 'panel'): a canopy's box only a few cm deep, its front painted by the viewer's drawing named in draw.
